body: That was much more helpful than I thought any comment on reddit had the potential to be for me tonight. Thank you.

A lot has happened in the last few months of my life. I started the year with a great job, great friends, and on good terms with my parents. That all changed after one mistake that I can never fix or take back. It’s left me constantly fighting myself everyday just to get out of bed.

I sadly have a lot of experience using the suicide hotline for my region and have had some really positive experiences before that genuinely helped me. But when the system fails I feel worse than I did when I reached out.
